public_context.environment_introduction:
# Environment Information

## Brief Introduction:  
This environment is a digital booking platform tailored for yoga studios and fitness centers.  
It maintains a dynamic schedule of yoga classes, tracks participant enrollments, and displays real-time availability.  
Users can search for classes by date and time, view details, and reserve a spot, making this setting ideal for the requested task of booking a yoga class tonight.

## Environment Rules / Constraints:  
- Class enrollment cannot exceed class capacity.
- Class must be in active status (not canceled) to accept bookings.
- Users may only book available classes (i.e., not full and scheduled for a future date/time).
- Each enrollment must be linked to a valid user and a valid class.
public_context.task:
You are the studio admin. For user USR2 (Brandon Lee), handle the cancellation of tonight’s evening class and secure an alternative booking:

- Tonight is 2024-07-08. The “Evening Stress Release” session scheduled between 17:00–20:00 has been canceled; cancel Brandon’s existing enrollment in that canceled class.
- Rebook Brandon into the next available evening yoga class this week (17:00–20:00 time window) that is active and not in the past. If the nearest suitable class is full, increase its capacity by one and then book Brandon into it.
- Confirm his account is active before booking, and ensure the new booking time does not overlap with any of his other current bookings.
- Do not change class statuses; only adjust capacity if needed to complete the rebooking.

function.description:
Retrieve all yoga classes scheduled for the specified date and time window.

Args:
    date (str): Target date in "YYYY-MM-DD" format.
    start_time (str): Start time of window in "HH:MM" (24-hour) format.
    end_time (str): End time of window in "HH:MM" format.

Returns:
    dict:
        success (bool): True if query runs, False if input error.
        data (List[ClassInfo]): List of all matching classes (may be empty).
        error (str): Optional error message in case of failure.

Constraints:
    - Returns all classes whose date matches the input date, and where
      class start_time >= window start_time and class end_time <= window end_time.
    - If any argument missing or time format clearly invalid, returns error.
function.name: list_classes_by_datetime

function.description:
Return all classes filtered by their current status.

Args:
    status (str): Desired status to filter classes by (e.g., "active", "canceled").

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[ClassInfo]  # List of classes where class['status'] == status
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of error, e.g. invalid status input
    }

Constraints:
    - status must be a non-empty string.
    - Returns an empty data list if no classes match the status.
function.name: filter_classes_by_status

function.description:
Get full information about a specific class, including location, instructor, times, status, and capacity.

Args:
    class_id (str): The class identifier.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": ClassInfo   # all details about the class
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str        # e.g., "Class not found"
    }

Constraints:
    - class_id must exist in the system.
function.name: get_class_details

function.description:
Check if the specified class is available for booking.

Args:
    class_id (str): The unique identifier of the yoga class to check.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "available": bool,        # True if class can accept bookings, else False
        "remaining_spots": int    # Number of spots available (0 if not available)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str              # Reason for failure (class not found, etc)
    }

Constraints:
    - Class must exist.
    - Class status must be "active".
    - Class's currently booked enrollments must be < capacity.
    - Only enrollments with status "booked" count towards capacity.
function.name: check_class_availability

function.description:
Retrieve information about the instructor for a specific class.

Args:
    class_id (str): The identifier of the class whose instructor information is requested.

Returns:
    dict:
        success: True and
            data: InstructorInfo (the instructor details)
        OR
        success: False and
            error: reason for failure (e.g., class not found, instructor not found)

Constraints:
    - The class specified by class_id must exist.
    - The instructor assigned to the class must exist.
function.name: get_instructor_details

function.description:
Get user information for a given user_id.

Args:
    user_id (str): The unique ID of the user to retrieve.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": UserInfo  # User details if found.
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # "User not found" if user does not exist.
    }

Constraints:
    - user_id must match an existing user in the system.
function.name: get_user_by_id

function.description:
Query the account status (active/disabled) for a user.

Args:
    user_id (str): The unique identifier of the user.

Returns:
    dict: 
        If user exists:
            {
                "success": True,
                "data": str  # account_status: "active", "disabled", etc.
            }
        If user does not exist:
            {
                "success": False,
                "error": "User not found"
            }

Constraints:
    - The user must exist in the system (self.users).
function.name: check_user_account_status

function.description:
List all current (booked/not canceled) enrollments for a specific class.

Args:
    class_id (str): Unique class identifier to query enrollments.

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "data": List[EnrollmentInfo],  # List of enrollment records (may be empty if no bookings)
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # e.g., "Class does not exist"
    }

Constraints:
    - The class_id must exist in self.classes.
    - Only "booked" enrollments (not "canceled") are considered current.
function.name: list_enrollments_for_class

function.description:
List all classes (enrollments) booked by a particular user.

Args:
    user_id (str): The user whose enrollments will be listed.

Returns:
    dict:
        - success: True, data: list of EnrollmentInfo (may be empty)
        - success: False, error: If user does not exist

Constraints:
    - user_id must correspond to a valid existing user.
    - Only returns enrollments with status 'booked'.
function.name: list_user_enrollments

function.description:
Books a class for the specified user by creating a new enrollment record.

Args:
    class_id (str): Identifier of the yoga class to book.
    user_id (str): Identifier of the user making the booking.

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {
              "success": True,
              "message": "Enrollment successful",
              "enrollment_id": str
          }
        - On failure: {
              "success": False,
              "error": str
          }

Constraints:
    - Class must exist and be active.
    - User must exist and have active account.
    - Enrollment count for the class must not exceed class capacity.
    - Class must be scheduled in the future.
    - User should not already be enrolled in the same class.
function.name: create_enrollment

function.description:
Cancel an existing enrollment (set status to 'canceled').

Args:
    enrollment_id (str): The unique identifier for the enrollment to cancel.

Returns:
    dict:
        success (bool): Whether the operation succeeded.
        message (str): Success info if canceled.
        error (str): Present if operation failed.

Constraints:
    - Enrollment_id must exist.
    - If already canceled, return success but with appropriate message.
    - Cancelling an enrollment may free up a spot in the associated class.
function.name: cancel_enrollment

function.description:
Change the status of a specific enrollment (e.g., "booked" to "canceled").

Args:
    enrollment_id (str): Unique identifier for the enrollment.
    new_status (str): New status to set ("booked", "canceled").

Returns:
    dict: 
        On success: { "success": True, "message": "Enrollment status updated." }
        On failure: { "success": False, "error": str }

Constraints:
    - Enrollment must exist in the system.
    - Status must be a valid value ("booked", "canceled").
function.name: update_enrollment_status

function.description:
Change the status of the specified class (e.g., mark as 'canceled' or 'active').

Args:
    class_id (str): Unique identifier of the class to update.
    new_status (str): Desired status value ('active', 'canceled').

Returns:
    dict: {
        "success": True,
        "message": "Class status updated to '<new_status>'."
    }
    or
    {
        "success": False,
        "error": str  # Description of reason (class not found, invalid status)
    }

Constraints:
    - Only 'active' or 'canceled' are valid status values.
    - The class must exist in the system.
function.name: update_class_status

function.description:
Update details of a specified yoga class.

Args:
    class_id (str): The ID of the class to update.
    updates (dict): Dictionary of fields to update and their new values.
        Allowed fields: title, date, start_time, end_time, location, instructor_id, capacity, status

Returns:
    dict:
        - On success: {"success": True, "message": "Class details updated."}
        - On failure: {"success": False, "error": str (reason)}

Constraints:
    - class_id must exist.
    - Fields in updates must be valid keys of ClassInfo.
    - If capacity is being decreased, the new capacity cannot be less than the number of current enrollments (else fail).
    - Cannot set capacity below 1.
function.name: modify_class_details

function.description:
Change information for a specific enrollment: user and/or class association.
Only user_id and class_id can be changed.
All changes must obey constraints:
  - Enrollment must link to valid user and class.
  - Target class must be 'active', not canceled, not full, scheduled for a future date/time.
  - Target user must be 'active'.

Args:
    enrollment_id (str): The enrollment to modify.
    new_user_id (str, optional): New user to associate (if given).
    new_class_id (str, optional): New class to associate (if given).

Returns:
    dict:
        - Success: { "success": True, "message": "Enrollment updated." }
        - Failure: { "success": False, "error": <reason> }
function.name: modify_enrollment_details

content.error: Class is not scheduled for the future
